units.source_text: 祓禊过后，三公主将入贺茂神社修行，当天举行正式的贺茂祭。

en.t: After the purification rites, the Third Princess was to enter Kamo Shrine for religious training, and on that day the formal Kamo Festival was held.
On this day, Lady Aoi did not go to watch the festivities.

units.source_text: 有人将祓禊日争夺车位的事件告诉了源氏大将。

en.t: Someone told General Genji about the incident on the day of the purification rites, when people had fought over carriage places.

units.source_text: 源氏大将觉得六条妃子的确受了委屈，很对她不起。

en.t: General Genji felt that the Rokujo lady had indeed been wronged, and he was deeply sorry toward her.

units.source_text: 他想：“葵姬为人忠厚稳重，只可惜虑事不周，有时不免冷酷无情。

en.t: He thought, "Lady Aoi is sincere, kind, and composed by nature; it is only a pity that she does not think matters through, and at times she cannot help seeming cold and heartless.
She herself does not mean to humiliate anyone.

units.source_text: 但她没有想到两女共事一夫，应该互相顾怜。

en.t: But she has not considered that when two women share one husband, they ought to show each other sympathy and care.

units.source_text: 于是她的下属便随顺她的作风，结果做出那件事来。

en.t: So her attendants followed the tone she set, and in the end they did that thing.

units.source_text: 六条妃子气度温雅，谦恭知耻，人品甚是高尚。

en.t: The Rokujo lady is gentle and elegant in bearing, modest and sensitive to shame, and truly noble in character.

units.source_text: 如今受此凌辱，定然不胜悲愤。”

en.t: Now that she has suffered such humiliation, she must surely be overcome with grief and anger."

units.source_text: 他觉得很抱歉，便亲自去访问。

en.t: Feeling very sorry, he went in person to visit her.

units.source_text: 此时六条妃子的女儿尚未赴禁中左卫门府入初斋院[\[7\]](#part1338.html#m7)，还留在邸内洁身斋戒。

en.t: At this time, the Rokujo lady's daughter had not yet gone to the Left Gate Guards' Office in the palace to enter as the first Saiin[\[7\]](#part1338.html#m7), and she was still remaining at home, purifying herself and keeping ritual abstinence.

units.source_text: 六条妃子就以不可亵渎神明为借口，回报他说不能安心会面，谢绝了他。

en.t: The Rokujo lady used the need not to defile the gods as her excuse, sent word back that she could not calmly meet him, and refused his visit.

units.source_text: 源氏大将认为此亦有理之言，只得独自发牢骚：“为什么如此呢？

en.t: General Genji thought this too was reasonable, and could only grumble to himself, "Why must things be like this?
They really ought to make peace with each other!"
